definitions: A marketing strategy in which the sales force is compensated not only for sales they personally generate, but also for the sales of other salespeople that they recruit.
A controversial business model that involves selling products or services through a network of distributors who earn commissions on their own sales and on the sales of those they recruit.
examples: She got involved in multi-level marketing.
Many people are skeptical of multi-level marketing.
The company uses multi-level marketing to sell its products.
